item.text: The National Anti-Corruption Commission investigated whether a senior Home Affairs official improperly influenced the recruitment of her sister's fiancé and assisted her sister in another recruitment process.
item.support:
into whether a Senior Executive Service staff 
member in the Department of Home Affairs had 
improperly used her position

item.text: The Commission found that the official abused her office and misused official information, amounting to serious and systemic corrupt conduct.
item.support:
The findings that the official engaged in conduct 
which was an abuse of her office as a public 
official and a misuse of official information

item.text: The Commission made no corrupt-conduct finding against the official's sister or her sister's fiancé.
item.support:
The Commission did not find that the official’s 
sister or her fiancé engaged in corrupt conduct.

item.text: The Commission made three recommendations covering recruitment conflicts of interest, access to interview questions and changes to Home Affairs recruitment policies.
